runware.label: Runware
runware.source: Runware Models API documentation: https://runware.ai/docs/models-api/media-storage for media upload and deletion; https://runware.ai/docs/models-api/authentication for HTTP requests and authentication. Other operation knowledge is attributed to the service's API documentation and parameter schemas.

auth.note: Studio authentication selects the private value or explicit environment source by service and authentication profile at execution time. The transport applies the value as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

envelope.request: A JSON array of task objects. Each task carries taskType and a client-generated taskUUID, and the task's own parameters at the top level of the object.
envelope.response: An object with data (one entry per finished task, carrying the taskUUID) or errors (one entry per refused task with code, message, parameter, documentation, and taskUUID). A submission can be refused per task while the request itself succeeds.

imageInference.input: model, positivePrompt, negativePrompt, width, height, steps, CFGScale, scheduler, seed, and optionally seedImage (the mediaUUID issued for this run's uploaded image) with strength

videoInference.input: model, positivePrompt, duration, width and height (or a resolution preset), and the input mode's media keys (frameImages, referenceImages) as uploaded mediaUUIDs; deliveryMethod async

getResponse.returns: the task's data entry when finished, with videoURL or imageURL; a status of processing otherwise

mediaStorage.purpose: upload or delete image, video, audio, and 3D media used as model inputs
mediaStorage.input: an HTTP JSON task with taskType mediaStorage and taskUUID; operation upload with media set to a provider-readable URL, or operation delete with media set to this run's owned mediaUUID
mediaStorage.returns: upload returns the actual mediaUUID and mediaURL; delete returns the deleted mediaUUID, with taskType, operation, and the request taskUUID
mediaStorage.note: The source URL must deliver the exact prepared carrier bytes. Each run records its own upload response and uses that mediaUUID for generation. After generated outputs are captured, delete only the uploaded mediaUUIDs owned by that run. Keep local sources and generated outputs.

imageUpscale.purpose: enlarge one image with an upscaler model
imageUpscale.input: model, inputs.image (the mediaUUID issued for this run's uploaded source), upscaleFactor, and the model's settings; outputType URL, outputFormat, and outputQuality as for imageInference

video.poll: getResponse by taskUUID at an interval of about ten seconds; a five-second clip returns in two to three minutes
video.terminal: videoURL present in the data entry
video.note: A task refused at submission (an error entry in the submission response) answers processing when polled afterwards and never finishes. Read the submission response before polling.

errors.shape: errors[] entries with code, message, parameter, and where the service offers it a documentation URL and the taskUUID

observed_codes.invalidVideoDurationInteger: duration outside the model's integer band; the band itself is a fact of the model's offering, not of the service
observed_codes.invalidTaskType: an unknown taskType; the response lists every supported task type
observed_codes.unsupportedIpAdapterModel: the adapter's architecture does not match the checkpoint's registered architecture string; the response names both

batch.value: several tasks in one request are accepted; this suite's projects send one task per request

adapter_compatibility.value: Adapter compatibility (IP-Adapter, ControlNet, LoRA) is checked against the architecture string the checkpoint was registered with, not against its weights. An uploaded checkpoint registered under a fine-tune family name can be refused adapters that the same weights accept when registered as the base family. The checkpoint upload schema declares the allowed architecture identifiers, including exactlyai_image, illustrious, noobai, pony, sd1x, sdxl, sdxllightning, sdxlturbo, z_image and z_image_turbo. The documentation does not say what the string changes at inference. One lineage rendered identically under noobai, sdxl, and illustrious registrations.
